eventDetail.scope: NNICE 2027 will serve as an international forum for cutting-edge research on neural networks, information engineering, and communication systems. Its research spectrum will cover AI and neural networks, convolutional neural networks, graph neural networks, reinforcement learning and meta-learning, natural language processing, information fusion and data mining, semantic information processing and visualization, big data analytics and data integration, 5G/6G mobile communication technology, satellite and fiber optic communication, quantum communication and iot communication, digital signal processing, and weak signal detection and enhancement for image, video, audio and radar signals. Keynote speeches, interactive activities and workshops will be held to enable participants to access the latest research achievements, conduct in-depth academic exchanges and build academic connections, which will boost technological innovation and academic progress across these thriving research areas.
